g.text: Neonatal Hyperbilirubinaemia · 신생아 고빌리루빈혈증 QSP Map
haem catabolism → albumin binding → UGT1A1 conjugation → enterohepatic shunt → photochemistry → blood-brain barrier
TSB is what we measure · Bf is what injures · the albumin isotherm is the map between them
